 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE S. B. PD. SINGH  ORAL ORDER 3 07-11-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2. Petitioner apprehends her arrest in connection with Gaurichak P.S.Case No. 214 of 2018 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 409, 420/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3.
As per the prosecution case, the petitioner ( Secretary) and the School- in-charge were running Bank Account of the School and both are joint signatory authority.

The petitioner and co-accused in-charge of School defalcated govt money Rs. 3,17,700/- of 1 ACR Scheme and Scheme of School Uniform, welfare scholarship, free Book not transferred in student Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.48851 of 2025(3) dt.07-11-2025 or parents bank account.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is a lady having no criminal antecedent and she is ready to pay half of the embezzled amount near about Rs. 1,59,000/- to the Bank Account from which the money has been withdrawn.
As per submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner, he will submit a receipt of deposit of Rs. 1,59,000/- to the account from which the money has been withdrawn.
The petitioner will file deposit slip by filing an affidavit.
5. Learned APP for the State opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, and also taking into consideration the materials available on record, the petitioner above named, in the event of her arrest/ surrender within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of this order, be released on anticipatory bail on Kalyani Devi vs The State Of Bihar on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198145317/
